grammar_title: 倒装句(否定副词前置 · Only+状语前置 · so/such…that 与虚拟条件省略倒装)
source: 上外版选必四 Unit 3 Grammar in Use:Inversion(部分倒装与完全倒装)。句子地道、答案唯一(干扰项为错误语序或错误助动词)。

points.point: 否定/半否定副词置于句首的部分倒装(Never/Hardly/No sooner/Not until/Seldom/Not only…)
points.overview: 当 never, never before, hardly…when, no sooner…than, not until, seldom, rarely, little, not only, on no account, nowhere 等否定或半否定词语置于句首时,主句用部分倒装:把助动词/情态动词/be 提到主语之前(do/does/did + 主语 + 动词原形;或 had/have + 主语 + 过去分词)。

points.point: “Only + 状语”置于句首的部分倒装(Only then / Only when / Only by / Only after…)
points.overview: 当 “only + 副词/介词短语/状语从句” 置于句首时,主句(而非从句)用部分倒装:把助动词/情态动词提到主语之前,如 Only then did people realise…;Only by working together could they finish it。

points.point: “so/such…that”倒装 与 虚拟条件句的省略倒装(Had/Were/Should…)
points.overview: ① So + 形容词/副词 或 Such + 名词 置于句首时,主句部分倒装(So important was the canal that…;Such was the fame that…)。② 虚拟条件句省略 if 时,把 had/were/should 提到主语前构成倒装:Had I known…(=If I had known);Were it not for…;Should you…。

questions.stem: Never before ____ such a long canal been dug by human hands.
questions.explanation: 否定词 Never before 置于句首,过去完成被动用 had 提前(had…been dug)。

questions.stem: Never ____ so clearly why people study the past.
questions.explanation: Never 置于句首要部分倒装,助动词 had 提到主语 I 之前。

questions.stem: Not until the railway was built ____ the Grand Canal lose its importance.
questions.explanation: Not until 状语前置,主句倒装用 did + 主语 + 动词原形 lose。

questions.stem: Not until he read the old records ____ the truth about the canal.
questions.explanation: Not until 前置,主句倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 learn。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ the tour of the Forbidden City begun when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 结构,前半用过去完成,倒装 had 提到主语前。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ the gates opened than thousands of visitors poured in.
questions.explanation: No sooner…than 结构,前句用过去完成倒装,had 提前。

questions.stem: Seldom ____ such a well-preserved ancient site.
questions.explanation: Seldom 置于句首,现在完成倒装,have 提到主语 we 之前。

questions.stem: Rarely ____ a canal played such a key role in a country’s history.
questions.explanation: Rarely 句首倒装,主语 a canal 为单数,用 has played。

questions.stem: Little ____ how much the canal would change their lives.
questions.explanation: Little 表否定置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 know。

questions.stem: Not only ____ the Grand Canal carry grain, but it also spread new ideas.
questions.explanation: Not only 置于句首,部分倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 carry。

questions.stem: Not only ____ goods along the route, but they also exchanged customs.
questions.explanation: Not only 句首部分倒装,did + 主语 + 原形 carry。

questions.stem: On no account ____ touch the priceless relics in the hall.
questions.explanation: On no account 表否定置于句首,倒装 should + 主语 + 原形 touch。

questions.stem: Nowhere else in China ____ so many old canal towns.
questions.explanation: Nowhere 表否定地点置于句首,倒装 can + 主语 + 原形 find。

questions.stem: Not for a moment ____ that the old city walls would be saved.
questions.explanation: Not for a moment 表否定置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 doubt。

questions.stem: By no means ____ an easy task to keep the canal flowing.
questions.explanation: By no means 表否定置于句首,系动词 was 提到主语 it 之前。

questions.stem: Never before ____ a project so large been attempted in the region.
questions.explanation: Never before + 过去完成被动,倒装 had 提前(had…been attempted)。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ the emperor announced the plan when work began at once.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when,前句用过去完成倒装,had 提前。

questions.stem: Seldom ____ the value of protecting these historic sites.
questions.explanation: Seldom 置于句首,一般现在倒装 do + 主语 + 原形 question。

questions.stem: Not until dusk ____ exploring the ruins of the old town.
questions.explanation: Not until 前置,主句倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 stop。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ off the boat than the guide began the tour.
questions.explanation: No sooner…than,过去完成倒装,had 提到主语 we 之前。

questions.stem: Only then ____ how important the canal had been to the empire.
questions.explanation: Only then 置于句首,主句部分倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 realise。

questions.stem: Only after years of digging ____ the two rivers finally linked.
questions.explanation: Only after… 状语前置,主句倒装;rivers 复数被动用 were…linked。

questions.stem: Only in this way ____ protect the ancient site for future generations.
questions.explanation: Only in this way 置于句首,倒装 can + 主语 we + 原形 protect。

questions.stem: Only when the war ended ____ the canal again.
questions.explanation: Only when… 置于句首,主句倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 repair。

questions.stem: Only by studying history ____ truly understand the present.
questions.explanation: Only by… 置于句首,倒装 can + 主语 we + 原形 understand。

questions.stem: Only after Marco Polo returned ____ about the wonders of the East.
questions.explanation: Only after… 置于句首,主句倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 learn。

questions.stem: Only then ____ the real purpose of the Grand Canal.
questions.explanation: Only then 置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 understand。

questions.stem: Only with careful planning ____ the old buildings be saved.
questions.explanation: Only with… 置于句首,倒装 could + 主语 + 被动原形 be saved。

questions.stem: Only after the bell rang ____ talking about the Silk Road.
questions.explanation: Only after… 置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 stop。

questions.stem: Only in recent years ____ to value these forgotten canal towns.
questions.explanation: Only in recent years 置于句首,现在完成倒装,have 提前。

questions.stem: Only when you walk the route yourself ____ its true length.
questions.explanation: Only when… 置于句首,一般现在倒装 do + 主语 + 原形 feel。

questions.stem: Only by working together ____ such a huge canal.
questions.explanation: Only by… 置于句首,倒装 could + 主语 + 原形 build。

questions.stem: Only after the museum opened online ____ visit it from home.
questions.explanation: Only after… 置于句首,倒装 could + 主语 + 原形 visit。

questions.stem: Only then ____ that the old maps were still useful.
questions.explanation: Only then 置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 discover。

questions.stem: Only through trade along the Silk Road ____ rich and powerful.
questions.explanation: Only through… 置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 grow。

questions.stem: Only if we record these stories ____ remember them.
questions.explanation: Only if… 置于句首,倒装 will + 主语 + 原形 remember。

questions.stem: Only after a long search ____ the lost section of the canal.
questions.explanation: Only after… 置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 find。

questions.stem: Only here ____ see the oldest part of the ancient waterway.
questions.explanation: Only here 置于句首,倒装 can + 主语 + 原形 see。

questions.stem: Only when the grain arrived ____ that the canal had saved the city.
questions.explanation: Only when… 置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 know。

questions.stem: Only by reading old records ____ piece together the lost past.
questions.explanation: Only by… 置于句首,倒装 can + 主语 + 原形 piece together。

questions.stem: So important ____ to trade that emperors kept it in good repair.
questions.explanation: So + 形容词 置于句首,主句倒装系动词 was + 主语 the canal。

questions.stem: Such ____ the fame of the Silk Road that traders came from far away.
questions.explanation: Such + be + 主语 结构;fame 为单数,用 was。

questions.stem: ____ the engineers known the danger, they would have changed the route.
questions.explanation: 虚拟条件省略 if,把 Had 提前构成倒装(=If the engineers had known)。

questions.stem: So heavy ____ the grain boats that they moved very slowly.
questions.explanation: So + 形容词 置于句首,boats 复数用 were。

questions.stem: ____ it not for the Grand Canal, the northern cities would have suffered.
questions.explanation: Were it not for… 固定倒装结构(=If it were not for)。

questions.stem: Such ____ his interest in history that he read every book about it.
questions.explanation: Such + be + 主语;interest 为单数,用 was。

questions.stem: ____ you ever visit Suzhou, you will see the old canal for yourself.
questions.explanation: Should you… 倒装表示将来可能(=If you should ever visit)。

questions.stem: So well ____ the ancient walls that they still stand today.
questions.explanation: So + 副词 置于句首,被动倒装;walls 复数用 were…built。

questions.stem: ____ the emperor not moved his capital, the canal might have stayed unused.
questions.explanation: 省略 if 的虚拟倒装:Had the emperor not moved…(=If the emperor had not moved)。

questions.stem: So clearly ____ the value of the past that the city saved its old streets.
questions.explanation: So + 副词 置于句首,主句倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 see。

questions.stem: Such ____ the crowds at the Forbidden City that tickets sold out early.
questions.explanation: Such + be + 主语;crowds 复数,用 were。

questions.stem: ____ we known how fragile the relics were, we would have been more careful.
questions.explanation: 省略 if 倒装:Had we known…(=If we had known)。

questions.stem: So famous ____ that millions of people visit it every year.
questions.explanation: So + 形容词 置于句首,现在时倒装 is + 单数主语。

questions.stem: ____ it not for Zhang Qian’s journeys, the trade routes might never have opened.
questions.explanation: Were it not for… 固定倒装结构。

questions.stem: So great ____ that the empire could not survive without it.
questions.explanation: So + 形容词 置于句首,倒装 was + 主语 value。

questions.stem: ____ you wish to learn more, the online museum is open day and night.
questions.explanation: Should you… 倒装(=If you should wish)。

questions.stem: Such ____ the importance of salt that it became a main source of income.
questions.explanation: Such + be + 主语;importance 为单数,用 was。

questions.stem: So slowly ____ that repairs took many years to finish.
questions.explanation: So + 副词 置于句首,倒装 did + 主语 + 原形 go。

questions.stem: ____ the canal not been rebuilt, grain could not have reached the north.
questions.explanation: 省略 if 倒装:Had the canal not been rebuilt…(=If the canal had not been rebuilt)。

questions.stem: Such ____ the beauty of the old town that artists came to paint it.
questions.explanation: Such + be + 主语;beauty 为单数,用 was。
